s: The Lava Lurk swims in lava, then pops its head out and shoots 4 fireballs that deal damage. A fireball can be destroyed by hitting it with a
. Players can hit a Lava Lurk when its head is visible, but not when it's swimming under lava. A Lava Lurk can deal direct damage if the player stands next to it.
Loot dropped when a Lava Lurk is killed does NOT go directly into the player's inventory.
